8.desc:
Zkittlez X Kush Mints

Blue Zushi is a slightly indica dominant hybrid strain created through crossing the delicious Zkittlez X Kush Mints strains. Known for its gorgeous appearance and pretty well balanced high, Blue Zushi is perfect for any indica lover. This bud has small and fluffy rounded forest green nugs with deep blue undertones, vivid orange hairs and a thick frosty coating of gorgeous tiny blue-tinted white crystal trichomes. As you pull apart each sparkling little nugget, aromas of spicy flowers and rich earthy pine are released, almost like walking through a forest after a rainstorm. The flavor is of sweet earth and spicy flowers with a mellow herbal tea-like taste that lingers on the tongue.

9.desc: Don't let the name fool you. This legendary hybrid is all about peace, love, and seriously good vibes. A true old-school classic, AK-47 delivers a bold bouquet of earthy spice, sweet florals, and a touch of skunky citrus. Expect an uplifting rush of cerebral euphoria, creative energy, and an easygoing body buzz that keeps things beautifully balanced. One hit of this classic, and you'll understand why it's been a crowd favorite for decades

11.desc:
GMO x OZ Kush Bx2 

Black Amber from Crops is a dank, indica-leaning hybrid with a rich gas-forward profile and a heavy, full-body finish. It was bred from GMO x OZ Kush Bx2, giving it a bold aroma that opens with sharp garlic and chemical funk, then layers in gassy, sweet candy notes on the exhale. The flavor is smooth but intense, with earthy spice, subtle sweetness, and a lingering resinous quality that lingers on the tongue.

The effects are typically strong and calming, starting with a heady euphoria before settling into deep physical relaxation. Many users report stress relief, body tension release, and a clear but mellow mental state, making Black Amber a good choice for evening wind-down or heavy-hitting sessions. Its potency can be high, so it often suits more experienced consumers.

Visually, Black Amber shows dense, chunky buds with dark green to near-black hues, bright orange pistils, and a thick coat of amber-tinged trichomes. Crops’ version leans into this strain’s go-to-sleep vibe: dark, pungent, and potent, with a smooth, gassy profile that feels both nostalgic and modern.

Red Velvet is a slightly indica dominant hybrid strain created through crossing the delicious Lemon Cherry Gelato X Pina Acai strains. Named for its amazing flavor, Red Velvet is the perfect mouthwatering bud for any indica love who loves a great taste with their medicine. Like its namesake treat, Red Velvet has a sweet chocolatey and creamy flavor with hints of fresh vanilla and a bouquet of fresh fruits. The aroma is of sour citrusy lemon with a creamy vanilla overtone that turns a bit spicy and woody as the nugs are broken apart and burned away. You'll feel mentally stimulated with a tingly sense that activates your senses, filling you with a boost in creativity and a substantial increase in happiness. GG#4 from Crops is a classic, heavy-hitting indica known for its sticky texture, loud aroma, and deeply relaxing effects. It typically carries a pungent blend of pine, diesel, chocolate, and earthy funk, with a sharp, almost chemical edge that makes it instantly recognizable. The flavor often mirrors the smell, delivering a rich, gassy inhale followed by a smooth, lingering finish.

The effects are usually strong and fast-acting. Many consumers describe an initial wave of euphoria and mental relief that quickly gives way to a heavy body calm. Visually, GG#4 usually features dense, resin-coated buds with bright green tones and orange pistils, giving it a frosty, top-shelf appearance. Crops’ version of GG#4 fits the strain’s reputation well: powerful, pungent, and satisfying for consumers who like classic gas-forward cannabis with a deeply soothing finish.

56.desc:
Alien Cookies x Kush Mints

Cap Junky is a modern “designer” hybrid born from a collaboration between Seed Junky
Genetics and Capulator that crosses Alien Cookies with Kush Mints. Structurally, the plants stay
short and stocky and throw off small, dense buds that look almost white under bright light
because of their thick trichome coverage. Potency is serious business here—buds routinely test
above 30 % THC and some samples top 40 %—so this isn’t a strain for lightweights or anyone
who needs to get things done. When cured properly, the resin is loaded with terpenes that give
off an aggressive bouquet of rotten fruit, pungent diesel and freshly cracked pepper, with smoke
that finishes smooth, gassy and sometimes hints at black pepper and ripe mango.
